assets.subject: A single torn half of a small map, visibly about half missing with one irregular torn edge. Abstract winding ink path and a few tiny geographic marks only, no readable lettering, no X treasure mark, no completed route or solved destination. Open unfolded flat fragment, slightly angled. The paper fragment itself may be muted pale lilac; no surrounding scenery.

One small EMPTY bird nest woven from softly painted twigs and a few muted turquoise fibers, intact despite having fallen. Resting low and level, seen from a gentle three-quarter angle; no branch, tree, eggs, chicks, birds, hands or airborne motion. Do not show it repaired or returned to a tree.

One SINGLE small child's mitten, soft coral knitted wool with a muted plum cuff, lying on its side with the thumb visible. No hand inside, no child, no second mitten, no snow, ground or scenery. Simple rounded knitted form with subtle painted stitch texture, no lettering.

One small antique GOLDEN KEY, warm muted ochre gold painted matte, a simple rounded bow and unmistakable short toothed shaft, gently diagonal. No lock, door, chest, holder, ribbon, jewelry or other objects. No magical glow; readable simple silhouette.

One small old WOODEN MUSIC BOX, simple box with a small winding handle on the side, lid modestly open showing a tiny simple metal musical cylinder. Rounded softly worn wood, muted lilac lid detail, muted coral accent. No ballerina, no figurine, no printed musical notes, no floating notes, no emitted light, no extra scene.

One colorful hanging PAPER LANTERN, rounded pleated paper shell with alternating muted lilac and coral panels, deep purple thin hanging loop, soft restrained warm light contained INSIDE the paper. Entire single lantern visible, no doorway, house, child or hand, no flame, no ocean or lighthouse, no beams or sparkle cloud.

One empty seashell with broad curved ribs, a simple recognisable shell, muted lilac outside, restrained turquoise shadow and soft coral interior. Entire shell visible, no creature inside, no pearl, no beach or ocean scene, no hand, no sound lines, no glowing magic.

One small BLUE glowing crystal stone. A softly faceted blue mineral, blue is the dominant color, with a soft restrained internal luminosity confined to the object, a little lilac shading. No pedestal, no magic explosion, no stars, no radiating beams, no hands, no scenery.

One OLD portable handheld lantern, softly weathered deep purple metal frame with a top carry handle, simple turquoise-tinted glass chamber containing a soft warm restrained light. Matte painted material, old but intact, not rusty dangerous. No visible flame, no human, no ground, no doorway, no scenery, no lighthouse or paper lantern. No light rays beyond the silhouette.

One simple small magnifying glass with a rounded muted purple handle, circular frame, softly turquoise tinted clear glass lens with subtle gouache reflection. Single object, complete silhouette, three-quarter tilted view, no insect, no magnified drawing or text, no hand, no scenery, no extra objects.

One soft fallen BIRD FEATHER, gently curved, with natural feather structure painted in restrained turquoise and lilac sections with a tiny coral accent. Entire feather visible, delicate soft barbs, no bird, no wing, no ground, no wind motion or sparkle, no other objects.

One long THICK STURDY ROPE resting as a simple loose coil with two visible intact ends. Muted natural ochre woven fiber with plum shadows, clearly rope not a ribbon or snake. No knot, no broken/frayed ends, no trap, no noose, no hands, no characters, no scenery or objects being tied.
